answer: By the grove of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. A hollow of per-task receipts records who did what, and the pearl of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
